content.short: Merit Circle is a DAO that educates and sponsors web3 gaming communities.
content.description: Merit Circle is a community-led DAO where gamers can loan in-game resources, including NFTs and capital, to start playing supported games and earn income. The governance model centers on member voting, which requires holding the MC governance token to participate in proposals and decisions. Since its early days, the DAO has invested in more than 70 games, including Axie Infinity and Sidus Heroes, engaging over 3,000 gamers and managing more than 100 million assets under management.
